body:
The ground beneath my feet trembled as I stood frozen, watching the tape snake around the gnarled trunk of the old oak. My heart raced, but not from fear. From curiosity, from an inexplicable desire to understand something deeper than logic could explain. Each twist and turn of the tape was like reading a secret code written in bark and leaf litter. 

My mind spun with theories - maybe this tree held ancient secrets or stories passed down through generations. But more important, there was something about its presence that made me want to know. It called out to me, inviting me closer without fully letting go.
